changes.sense: Order-theoretic least: in two occurrences the least upper bound, and in the third the least rational number among those greater than sqrt(2).
changes.rationale: All three occurrence groups use least in its minimum-in-an-order sense. The Cauchy and Dedekind-cut passages identify a candidate upper bound and prove it is no greater than every other upper bound; the rational-line passage denies a smallest rational above sqrt(2). DAM defines least upper bound with that same comparison property and uses أصغر in its headword أصغر راجح (الحد الأعلى). Thus أصغر is directly supported as the least component, although the project's full phrase حد علوي differs from the canon's full headword. This is a present-day source-and-canon reassessment only; it does not claim to recover the original translator's deliberation and proposes no automatic change to translation text.
